visual_action: A wide shot from within a large, crowded arena at night, looking towards a UFC-style fighting octagon. In the background, beyond the crowd and octagon, fireworks explode in the sky near what appears to be the Washington Monument. The camera pans slightly across the crowd, many of whom have their backs to the camera or are milling about. Staff wearing shirts that say "PRODUCTION" are visible in the foreground.

on_screen_text.text: The end of an EPIC night at UFC Freedom 250

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; the audio consists of loud music and crowd noise.
audio_music: An upbeat, high-energy rock or metal track with a prominent electric guitar riff plays throughout the clip, accompanied by the sounds of a large, cheering crowd. The effect is celebratory and exciting.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, continuous handheld shot with a slight pan across the scene. There are no cuts or other edits.
central_claim: The White House hosted or was involved in a large, exciting, and successful event called "UFC Freedom 250."
intended_effect: To generate excitement and convey a sense of a grand, patriotic, and popular event.
